prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 87.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 93.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 75.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 38.4%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move Sign-In After Pet Adoption', 'Interactive Desktop Waiting Room', 'Photo Quality Guide & Companion Preview', 'Choose Path Clarity Headline Update', 'System Tray Location & Shortcut Notification Tip', 'Multi-Device Account Sync Banner', 'Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence', 'Background Hatching Desktop Readiness Status', 'Desktop Visibility Status Check Wait Info', 'Split Upload Companion Preview Layout', 'Path Selection Spotlight Layout', 'Story Stage Visual Redesign', 'Desktop Spawn Location Hint', 'Existing Pet Account Recovery Copy', 'Interactive Home Desktop Spawn Placement Flow', 'Spotlight Path Selection Screen Redesign']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Move Sign-In to Onboarding Hand-off', 'Simplified Onboarding Path Selection Copy', 'Live 3D Render Hatching Progress Tracker', 'Move Sign-In After Waiting Room', 'Pick Friend Compact Grid Layout', 'Waiting Completion Desktop Sound Notification', 'Split Photo Upload Quality Assistant', 'Desktop Mascot Welcome Greeting Stage', 'Path Selection Time Expectation Banner', 'System Tray Desktop Spawn Alert Prompt', 'Story Intro Value Proposition Refresh', 'First Interaction Desktop Notification Tip', 'Photo Generation Fallback Assistant Flow', 'Choose Path Clear Outcome Headline', 'Desktop Render Readiness Progress Details', 'Existing Account Pet Sync Verification Hint', 'Home Intro Desktop Mascot Interaction Badge', 'Custom Photo Upload Quality Guidelines Banner', 'Existing Account Pet Restoration Callout', 'Story Screen Value Focus Refresh', 'Desktop Hatching Animation Progress Status', 'Desktop Pet Visibility & Tray Controls Tip', 'Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Redesign', 'Sign-In Before Adoption Handoff Reorder', 'Desktop Docking Hint on Welcome Screen', 'Story Welcome Card Showcase Layout', 'Desktop Pet Direct Controls Guide', 'Existing Account Pet Sync Reassurance Banner', 'Waiting Screen Completion Timer Display', 'Interactive Desktop Companion Stage Layout', 'Starter Desktop Pet Name Badge', 'Reorder Sign-In to Post-Waiting Stage', 'Background Generation Stage Notification Prompt', 'Path Choice Checklist Selection Layout', 'Adoption Certificate Ownership Preservation Guarantee', 'Companion Pre-Adoption Review Flow', 'System Tray Desktop Companion Retrieval Callout', 'Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Notice', 'Desktop Background Render Activity Display', 'Interactive Home Welcome Stage Layout', 'Story Scroll Visual Narrative Redesign', 'Cloud Account Pet Sync Security Badge', 'Background Generation Desktop Ready Notification', 'Certificate Stage Layout Customization']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Guided Companion Selector Flow', 'Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen', 'Account Persistence Clarification Hint', 'Path Options Grid with Time Estimates', 'Explicit Desktop Spawn Call to Action', 'Story Screen Fast-Forward Button', 'Story Narrative Companion Carousel Redesign', 'Pet Personality Calibration Screen', 'Interactive Mini Games Waiting Experience', 'Custom Pet Generation Guarantee Badge', 'Desktop Interaction Shortcut Checklist Layout', 'Split-Stage Adoption Certificate Design', 'Adoption Certificate Starter Perk Badge', 'Visual Path Choice Spotlight Showcase', 'Persistent Account Session Split View', 'Custom Pet Style Selection Showcase', 'Interactive Companion Trait Onboarding Flow', 'Adoption Naming Bonus Perk', 'Pick Friend Two Column Showcase', 'Post-Onboarding Pet Care Quick Start Screen', 'Pick Friend Full Bleed Carousel Redesign', 'Reorder Story Screen After Path Choice', 'Adoption Certificate Split Screen Layout', 'Choose Path Choice Cards Redesign', 'Pet Companion Habit Selection Screen', 'Interactive Desktop Companion Control Showcase', 'Move Sign-In Post Desktop Welcome Stage', 'Interactive Adoption Certificate Stamp Redesign', 'First Launch Companion Incentive Badge', 'Pick Friend Stage Preview Layout', 'Multi-Angle Photo Preview Flow', 'Story Deck Split Layout Redesign', 'New Custom Pet Generation Verification Screen', 'Adoption Companion Starter Outfit Badge', 'Split Layout Photo Upload Interface', 'Desktop Navigation Controls Overview Stage', 'Interactive Pet Trait Selection Flow', 'Desktop Hatching Stage Screen', 'Path Selection Direct Outcome Headline']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Post-adoption/certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sign-in reorders and sync hints showed no clear effect.
Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and certain visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts and story scroll narrative redesigns hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and background activity displays showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption review flows, ownership guarantees, and layout customization showed no clear effect.
Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while mascot greetings, docking hints, retrieval callouts, and welcome stage redesigns showed no clear effect.
Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide, story scroll redesign).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Photo Upload Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a stage layout with live asset preview integration.
candidates.why: Support received 3 tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong, and adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 68.9%.

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated verification screen right before onboarding completion to confirm pet desktop rendering and position.
candidates.why: Support reported multiple complaints of pets missing from the desktop, and the finish step has a high mean duration of 5815s.

new_desktop_verify.headline: Verify Desktop Pet Placement
new_desktop_verify.body: Confirm your companion appears clearly on your desktop screen before continuing.

candidates.title: Path Selection Stage Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen using a prominent stage layout that replaces standard path selection options with visual choice cards.
candidates.why: Path selection has an 87.0% conversion rate with a long mean duration (514s), suggesting user uncertainty about choices.

candidates.title: Multi-Step Photo Quality Inspection Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a split-layout photo inspection flow with real-time feedback and photo tips during upload.
candidates.why: 3 support emails specifically reported custom pet creation issues or incorrect pet appearances.

components.text: Use clear lighting for best custom pet generation

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Delivery Progress Stage Indicator
candidates.change: Add detailed progress tracking and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop assets render.
candidates.why: Home waiting median duration is 201s (mean 2336s); progress visibility reassures users while assets download.

waiting.hint: Preparing companion graphics for your desktop...

candidates.title: Account Sync & Pet Recovery Notification Banner
candidates.change: Display a explicit account recovery hint explaining that signing in safeguards companion data across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the single largest theme) reported lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet data so companions are never lost across device sign-ins.

candidates.title: Home Welcome Split Screen Showcase
candidates.change: Change the home intro screen layout to split view featuring pet welcome graphics and completion confirmation.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 24.6% with extremely high mean time (5815s); clean structure helps users complete setup.

candidates.title: Starter Pet Companion Badge Prompt
candidates.change: Add an incentive badge to the path selection screen highlighting instant companion unlocks.
candidates.why: 13.0% of users drop off at choose_path within a median of 8s; visible perks encourage progression.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Add a reassurance hint on the adoption certificate screen promising multi-device account preservation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (31.1% abandon) and account pet loss was reported 8 times in support.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your adoption certificate and pet traits are linked to your profile automatically.

candidates.title: Seamless Account Restore Headline Refresh
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly state pet restoration and cross-device syncing.
candidates.why: Clear sign-in messaging addresses user confusion around missing pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Keep your desktop pets safe and synchronized across all your devices seamlessly.
